experiment: MSL buffer clamp, direct word access, inline scalar constants and proven zero-init removal (591fde1ee, on top of the SPIR-V-only 1dfd5e009) against main (fac2bc042) and Dawn on apple-host Metal. Scoped native drop-in phase diagnostic; separate backend evidence.

host.label: apple-host
host.machine: Apple M3 (8 CPU, 10 GPU cores), 24 GiB
host.sharedUse: desktop session; the coordinator reports the computer-use sessions closed; a separate Metal campaign agent shares the GPU through /tmp/doe-gpu-timing.lock

providers.main: libwebgpu_doe_c.dylib from git archive of fac2bc042 (runtime/c/native default flags, Apple clang)
providers.dawn: Dawn 200d6641a51e57890983d842bd871d898e48bda5 (2026-05-25), GN is_debug=false, Metal only, the repository's existing vendor build (its working tree changes only tint bench sources outside the library); not the d04f88359 revision of the apple-metal 20261030 campaign
providers.dawn-aa: byte-identical copy of the dawn harness (A/A)

workloadNote: the two workloads with a shader; buffer_upload_readback_exact_1mb compiles no shader and is excluded

sampling.orders: all 24 permutations of the 4 providers, each twice

warmup: before each window, inside the same lock hold, one untimed pass (1 pair, 4 iterations, all providers) so every provider's MSL is in the Metal compiler cache; cold compiles measured 36-60 ms (Doe) before warm-up and about 2 ms after
timing: CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW host clock (harness), not GPU timestamps
statistics: dropin_phase_cohort summarize: per-pair ratio medians with bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed 20261029); summarized against control main and control dawn

rules.classification: per metric and workload: improvement if ratio CI95 upper < 1.0; regression if CI95 lower > 1.0; otherwise no detectable difference

validity: every process status ok with all 32 iterations oracle-checked
every provider reports the Apple M3 Metal adapter

window gate tools/mac_window.py (apple-metal 20261030 b2 tool): power source and low-power mode unchanged, no thermal warning, idle GPU median <= 25% before and after, foreign CPU <= 20% of run-interval capacity
acceptance.invalidWindows: at most two fresh attempts per workload; invalid attempts are retained and never used
acceptance.claimBoundary: A result is scoped to these two drop-in workloads on apple-host with these frozen binaries. It is not an application win, does not qualify Metal support and does not transfer to Vulkan or D3D12.
